name: Skywalker OG
notes: The Bread Gang / 1017 production-and-mix bench — producer *and* mixing and mastering engineer on the projects he works, which is why they share one tonal signature. His model is that signature. (1) The kit is mixed low and dry against a wide reverberant bed, so the velocity tiers are among the lowest here (54–100), percs sit at −8 dB and the rolls are restrained: `pitchWalk` 3 and `gapProb` 0.6, a fill that keeps getting out of the way. (2) The documented instrument set is guitar, bass, mellotron, strings and piano, so this is **pad harmony rather than a drone** — i–VI and i–VII families over 4-bar loops, `voicing` open across 46–78 with sustained `topVoiceStepwise` motion and sevenths at 0.3. (3) The research names a separately played bass alongside the tuned 808 on several tracks, one of the few modern Memphis sets where the sub is not the only low voice: `independent_riff` at `followRootsProb` 0.58 over a 20-semitone register. The melody is the deliberate opposite of a hook — 1–3 notes a bar over 4- and 8-bar phrases, `octaveJumpProb` 0.04, step-weighted intervals — because the research says the melodic interest comes from timbre and reverb rather than from movement, and `switchUpProb` 0.01 because there are no beat switches. ⛔ `low` because the research rates it medium-low: his production and mix role and the project instrumentation are sourced, **and the 128–152 straight tempo band plus every drum value are lane inferences**. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 46 to 45 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 46 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 1. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 902 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 940/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: answer_lick, bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,3] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 976/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.32 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 976/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
